connect.signedOutLead: Sign in to connect your companion.

connect.consent: Forever Sixty will see your BattleTag and character list. It cannot see your password or play for you.
connect.pendingBody: The companion will upload your combat logs and install your chosen builds in the addon. You can remove it any time in Account > Devices.

connect.usedBody: If this was not you, remove it in Account > Devices.
connect.failedBody: Your device was not connected. Check your connection and try again.

addon.flowInBody: Save a build here, press Copy for the game, then type /fs in game and paste it.

addon.surfacesTitle: What it does in the game

surfaces.title: The Forever Sixty line
surfaces.body: A small icon and line beside the minimap that names your next step: the talent to take, a bag item to equip, loot here for you, or what a raid check found missing.

images.alt: The Forever Sixty line beside the minimap with its hover open: “Forever Sixty · Beast Mastery / Marksmanship build”, “Next talent at 25: Lethal Attacks”, the legend lines “Green arrow: a bag item beats what you wear.” and “Gold corner: next upgrade to chase.”, then the click, right-click and shift-drag hints.

surfaces.title: Talent marks
surfaces.body: In the talent window, a gold ring marks the next talent, every talent your build takes carries its order number, and a strip along the bottom counts your progress and any points spent off plan.

images.alt: A hunter’s talent window, Beast Mastery, Marksmanship and Survival, with small order marks on the planned talents, one ringed in gold in Marksmanship, and the strip along the bottom naming Lethal Attacks (1 of 5) as the next talent, 12 of 51 points spent and 3 off plan, the last part in red.

surfaces.title: Item tooltip
surfaces.body: Every item tooltip gains one line saying whether the item is an upgrade and by how much, or on what you wear, the next upgrade and where it drops, with the details under Shift.

images.alt: A level 24 hunter’s worn Short Ash Bow tooltip on the character panel. Straight after the game’s own lines, one white line, “Next upgrade: Ranger Bow +3.5 DPS”, and under it “World drop”, with the Ranger Bow’s own tooltip beside it. Held Shift adds “+1 Agi”, “Also good: Lil Timmy’s Peashooter +2.2 (gun)” and “Cracked Blacksmith Hammer +0.8 (thrown)”.

surfaces.title: Paper doll, bags, quest rewards, rolls
surfaces.body: A green arrow marks a paper-doll slot and the bag item that beats it, a gold corner marks a slot with an upgrade to chase, the quest reward your spec prefers is marked, and the roll frame shows the tooltip’s verdict beside the item.

images.alt: The top of the Combined Backpack with a small green arrow on the top-right corner of an item in the second row of the backpack: a bag item that beats what the character wears.

surfaces.title: The "Forever Sixty" character-panel tab
surfaces.body: A tab on the character panel with your next gear targets, your rotation for your level and your build; at 60 it adds your sim and your last raid.

images.alt: The Forever Sixty tab for a level 24 hunter: Next targets lists Ranger Bow +3.5 DPS (Ranged, World drop) and Blackened Defias Belt +1.1 DPS (Waist, The Deadmines, Captain Greenskin, 30% drop); Rotation lists Aimed Shot, Multi-Shot, Serpent Sting and Arcane Shot with their conditions, and Rapid Fire dimmed at level 26; Build reads “Plan: Beast Mastery 31 / Marksmanship 20”, “12 of 15 points on plan” and “3 off plan” in red, over the buttons Use a different build and Copy my character.

surfaces.title: The player tooltip and the score
surfaces.body: Every player tooltip carries that player’s Forever Score, and in LFG, Trade, guild chat and whispers a sender with a score gets an FS badge before their message.

images.alt: A player tooltip for Bow Jackzon, level 24 hunter, with the line “Forever Score 1240 · Rare · as of 13 Oct” in blue and the muted hint “Shift: score details · target them, then /fs link” under the client’s own lines.
A guild chat line, “[Guild] [Bow Jackzon]: FS 1240 · (addon test 3)”, with “FS 1240” in blue and a muted dot before the message.

surfaces.title: Guild tab
surfaces.body: A tab on the guild frame lists the roster’s level, spec, gear, Forever Score, attendance and gear gap, sortable, live for members who run the addon.

images.alt: The Forever Sixty guild tab: “Online only” unticked, “97 of 97 shown · 2 of 3 online run Forever Sixty · 1-20 of 97”, and columns Name, Level, Spec, Gear, Score (sorted), Attendance and Gap, with scored rows for Belee Dat (Frost, 2310), Onearm Lopen (Arms, 1720, gap 14 DPS) and Bow Jackzon (Beast Mastery, 1240, gap 0 DPS), then two dimmed rows and “no logs” for the rest.

surfaces.title: Group panel
surfaces.body: A tab on the raid frame shows each member’s spec, level, gear gap and score before the first pull, and on a ready check lists who lacks flask, food, weapon imbue or a class buff.

images.alt: The Forever Sixty group panel while solo: “Not in a group.” then, muted, “A party or raid shows each member’s spec, gear gap, score and buffs. /fs ready tries the check on you.”

surfaces.title: Guild and raid messaging
surfaces.body: Addons in your guild, raid or party share level, spec, gear gap and build name, pass builds to each other, and tell the master looter what a drop is worth to each member.

surfaces.title: Build dialog
surfaces.body: The addon’s one window of its own, where you paste a build from this site to follow it or copy your character to paste here.

images.alt: The build dialog for a hunter on Paste a build: “Following: Beast Mastery / Marksmanship build · Hunter · 51 po…”, “Next talent: Take Lethal Attacks (Marksmanship, 1 of 5)”, and the empty box “Paste a build code from foreversixty.gg (Ctrl+V)”, with “Tab to switch” at the bottom.
The build dialog’s head, “Forever Sixty”, with its two tabs, Paste a build and Copy my character, the second one selected.

surfaces.title: Settings
surfaces.body: Eight switches on the client’s Settings page, each with one line saying what it does, then Reset positions and the command list.

images.alt: The Forever Sixty settings page with its eight switches ticked, each with its hint: Show the Forever Sixty line, Hide the Forever Sixty line in combat, Marks on the talent window, Show the minimap button, Gear tips on item tooltips, Score badges in chat, Share my build with my guild and Save my character for the companion app, then the Reset positions button.

commands.description: copy my character for the site
show or hide the Forever Sixty line
gear and talents of your target
your group's specs, gear and buffs

your jobs for the next raid
what an item is worth to you

handshake: When you log out, the addon saves your character export (level, spec, talents, equipped gear, and bags when the bag switch is on), any sim request and the guild tab’s live roster.

The roster is saved only while “Share my build with my guild” is on, and members who opted out appear as “seen HH:MM” only; the companion uploads all of it and brings back what the site has for you, builds and sim results included.
The build dialog’s Copy my character tab then says “Site has your save from” and how long ago once the site has your latest copy, and “Not sent to the site yet · log out to send” until then.
